Listing identity excerpts are transcriptions of the exact fields the official record prints. Filing-based listings quote the Section 12(b) cover table. London Stock Exchange listings quote the instrument record fields including issuername, tidm, csm and islse, from which the exchange value LSE is taken. Deutsche Boerse and Borsa Italiana listings transcribe the printed instrument record values in the order name, symbol, ISIN, venue.

Ten links are left OPEN rather than closed. That is a statement about this run's reach, not about the world: sec.gov returned 403 to every request, several investor-relations hosts timed out, and annual reports above ten megabytes could not be opened, so issuers that plainly belong on these links (RTX, Hanwha Aerospace, Poongsan, Saab, Kongsberg, Thales, Safran, LIG Nex1, Solar Industries India, NewMarket, Park Aerospace) could not have their official listing records opened and were therefore not placed. Closing those links EXHAUSTED at the counts reached here would have been a false census, so they stay OPEN for the next universe run.

Only three links are closed. allied-rearmament-demand reached twelve distinct public issuers. nitration-feedstocks, nondestructive-inspection and dod-munitions-procurement close EXHAUSTED because their public universe is genuinely below ten, proved by multi-source censuses on one shared qualification boundary each.
